name: Azeroth Companion
title: Account Persistence & Unlock Intelligence
features: Prepared a new secure Cloudflare Worker release that extends the private encrypted Battle.net session up to the actual Blizzard token lifetime, strictly capped at 24 hours; owner must deploy the Worker separately.
Increased the public companion's independently encrypted and server-validated connection-status receipt to at most 15 minutes, without storing account tokens in GitHub Pages.

Added a read-only progress health panel in My Azeroth showing locally saved talent drafts and item/farming goals, with direct access to the existing Sovereign Data Vault. Authentication expiration does not erase local progress.

Prepared the private account Unlocks & Collections explorer for Blizzard-reported mounts, pets, toys, heirlooms and completed achievements of an authorized character; features become live only after the Worker deployment.
Preserved existing equipped gear research; does not claim to read complete bags, banks, or all live currency balances because those are not provided by the current Battle.net web API integration.
No data migrations, token leaks, new client secrets or changes to HYPER MUSIC or Founder identity. Full live OAuth, Cloudflare and browser acceptance tests are pending.
